Summary

CVE-2026-5415 is an authentication bypass in the WP Captcha PRO WordPress plugin that lets an authenticated Subscriber-level user escalate to any other account, including Administrators. The plugin’s AJAX handler for creating temporary login links relies on a nonce that is exposed client-side via wp_localize_script() on admin-accessible pages. Because the nonce is not properly scoped to privileged roles, a low-privileged user who can reach any admin-rendered page can read the nonce, call the AJAX action with an arbitrary user_id, and receive a temporary login link for that account — then simply visit the link to become authenticated as the target user.
